entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Nilesh Manore - Advocate for the applicant.
 Shri Madhusudan Yadav - G.A. appearing on behalf of Adv  ORDER 1] They are heard.

2] This is the applicant's first application under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 / 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.101/2024 registered at Police Station Jhabua, District Jhabua (MP) for offence punishable under Section Section 363, 366, 376(2)N of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and Section 3(1)(2)(i), 3(1)(w)(ii) of SC/ST Act.
The applicant is in custody since 03/03/2024.
3] Allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the age of the prosecutrix is disputed and she was a consenting party and has resided with the applicant for more than one month and she has already been examined in the tria Court and there are material omissions and contradictions in her statement.
It is further submitted that the charge sheet has already been filed, applicant is lodged in jail since 03/03/2024 and the final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time.

Hence, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed and he be NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:21098 2 MCRC-31020-2025 released on bail.
5] Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for grant of bail is made out.

Anupam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26959019/
1 6] Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary, considering the fact that the prosecutrix has resided with the applicant for around one months and she has already been examined, and the age of the prosecutrix is in dispute and final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time, in the considered opinion of this Court, the applicant's application deserves to be allowed.
7] Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

sentences.text:
The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/-
(rupees twenty five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
